title: 第17章 难道是巧合第18章 雨落成冰
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
这声巨响，响彻了天际。
甚至连直播间的网友们，都清清楚楚的听到了。
【卧槽，什么情况？】
【主播你那边怎么了？是什么东西爆炸的声音吗？】
【不对啊，主播不是在学校吗？这么大的爆炸声，难道是餐厅？】
【主播？主播！
怎么不说话了？】
网友们都被这一声巨响惊了一跳，见林楠也不开口，直直的盯着窗外看，都纷纷担心起了他那边的情况。
而林楠也在巨响发出的第一时间里，便已经转头看向窗外了。
其他人不知道这声巨响是怎么回事，但是作为画阵施法者的他又怎么会不明白呢。
果不其然，在巨响发出的下一瞬间，林楠看到了宿舍窗玻璃上，一滴接着一滴的雨水，正不断的滴落下来。
真的下雨了！
果然有了法力之后，就能够施展神明的能力了！
看着天空中不断飘落的雨滴，林楠的心中非常激动。
在得到系统前，谁又能想到，普通人竟然也可以拥有神明才有的能力呢？
在确认了雨水落下之后，他的注意力这才放回了直播间。
却没想到，短短的几十秒的时间里，评论区已经充满了网友们担心的声音。
见大家误会了，林楠这才开口解释道：
“大家不要担心，刚刚不是爆炸声，只是比较大的雷声而已。”
他边说着边将手机镜头朝向窗外。

“你们看，现在外面正在下雨，刚刚的巨响就是下雨前的雷声。”
【我擦，吓死我了，还以为是什么爆炸了，还好只是打雷。
【就是说啊，这声闷雷也太响了些。
【主播你刚刚一直看着窗外，也不说话，我当时还以为是出现什么问题了。
【不对啊！
主播刚才才在操场上求雨，现在就下雨了，这是不是也有些太巧了啊？】
【难道说，主播当时真的被雷祖上身了？！
当直播间的网友们，意识到了事情实在是有些太过于巧合之后。
那些本就信神的人，更是纷纷发送着评论，又开始在评论区里拜上了。
【九天应元雷声普化天尊在上，请保佑我们村风调雨顺！
【上香.jpg】
【天尊保佑……】
林楠哭笑不得的看着评论区，想让网友们赶紧打住，每天一遍，他这凡体肉身的可受不了啊！
content_en:
This loud noise resounded throughout the sky.
Even the netizens in the live broadcast room heard it clearly.
[Holy shit, what’s going on? 】
[Anchor, what's wrong with you over there? Is that the sound of something exploding? 】
[No, isn’t the anchor at school? With such a loud explosion, could it be a restaurant? 】
[Anchor? Anchor!
Why don't you speak? 】
Netizens were all startled by the loud noise. Seeing that Lin Nan did not speak and stared straight out the window, they all became worried about the situation over there.
Lin Nan also turned to look out the window as soon as the loud noise was heard.
Others didn't know what the loud noise was about, but as a spell caster, how could he not understand.
Sure enough, the moment after the loud noise came out, Lin Nan saw raindrops falling one after another on the window glass of the dormitory.
It's really raining!
Sure enough, once you have mana, you can use the power of gods!
Looking at the raindrops falling in the sky, Lin Nan felt very excited.
Before getting the system, who would have thought that ordinary people could also have abilities that only gods can have?
After confirming that the rain had fallen, his attention returned to the live broadcast room.
Unexpectedly, in just a few dozen seconds, the comment area was filled with worried voices from netizens.
Seeing that everyone had misunderstood, Lin Nan opened his mouth to explain:
"Don't worry, everyone, it wasn't an explosion just now, it was just a relatively loud thunder."
As he spoke, he pointed the camera of his phone out the window.
"Look, it's raining outside now, and the loud noise just now was the thunder before the rain."
[Oh, I was scared to death. I thought something exploded, but luckily it was just thunder.
[That is to say, this muffled thunder was too loud.
[Anchor, you just kept looking out the window and didn't speak. I thought something was wrong at the time.
【That’s not right!
The anchor just prayed for rain on the playground, and now it's raining. Isn't this a bit too coincidental? 】
[Could it be that the anchor was really possessed by Lei Zu at that time? !
When netizens in the live broadcast room realized that things were too much of a coincidence.
Those who already believed in God sent comments one after another and began to worship in the comment area.
[The Nine Heavens respond to the sound of thunder and universalize the Heavenly Lord. Please bless our village to have good weather!
【Shangxiang.jpg】
【God bless you...】
Lin Nan looked at the comment section dumbfounded, wanting netizens to stop immediately. He repeated this every day, and his mortal body couldn't bear it!
